name: Archival Documentary Reconstruction
description: Photographic reconstruction with restrained sepia monochrome, authentic materials, and aged documentary atmosphere.
style_bible: photographic reconstruction, candid observational staging rather than theatrical posing, warm charcoal-sepia monochrome, restrained contrast with softly lifted highlights and deep but readable blacks, natural lens falloff, subtle silver-gelatin emulsion grain, faint dust and occasional hairline scratches, gently uneven exposure, soft vignette, modest depth of field, convincing monochrome photographic texture
negative_prompt: glossy colour photography, vivid saturation, cinematic blockbuster lighting, polished CGI, painterly illustration, ink wash, cartoon, copied photograph, specific living person's likeness, readable captions, labels, logos, watermark, player UI, borders, letterbox bars, extreme film damage that obscures the subject
